_note: Gear v1 weapon catalog (data-driven, same pattern as abilities.json). damageMult joins the hero's damage chain (base x talent x level x timing x WEAPON). reach = MELEE hitbox radius in metres for MELEE jobs (knight) — overrides PlayerAttackController's fixed AttackRange (3.2) when >0; a heavier/longer blade outreaches a lighter one. Ranged jobs (mage/ranger) attack via AbilityDef.Range and leave reach 0 (unset) so their range is unchanged. req starts level-gated; add dex/arcane/might keys later. icon = emoji placeholder until real art ships (swap the field, zero code change). PRICING (buyWood/buyFood/buyIron/buyCrystals): tiered by rarity (common floor -> legendary sink, ~2.5x/tier); CRYSTALS gate rare+ (the aether/crystal arc); resource mix reflects the weapon's nature (knight=iron blade, ranger=wood bow, mage=wood staff + crystal head). Lean economy by design.

weapons.name: Arcane Scepter
weapons.flavor: Cut in the Bright Centuries, when an Elarion-forged head still drank the Heart's light without dimming.

weapons.name: Voidcaller Staff
weapons.flavor: A late-age masterwork. Pressed to the ear in a quiet room, the crystal is said to hum the old singing note.

weapons.name: Oathkeeper
weapons.flavor: Such blades sealed the highest bonds — given at sworn-knightings, written into wills above land.

weapons.name: Dawnbreaker
weapons.flavor: Kin to the lost Dawnedge, gifted to a southern queen at her crowning. To hold one was to be someone.

weapons.name: Stormrender Bow
weapons.flavor: Its limbs were grown, not cut — living wood from the Lumbermill that never wearied the arm.

weapons.name: Eclipse Recurve
weapons.flavor: A true Heartwood-marked bow. Merchants who could say 'this is Elarion-marked' had already named their price.

weapons.name: Emberbrand, the Rekindled
weapons.saga: Borin reforged the snapped hilt with the Threefold Fold; Wren's Last Pressing let the steel drink aether without shattering. A combo finisher releases the stored aether as a shock.

weapons.name: Heartwood Longbow
weapons.saga: Pell's living-wood limbs, given by the Tree rather than taken. Charged shots pierce and 'remember' the last struck foe.

weapons.name: Aetherstaff
weapons.saga: A quench-bonded crystal head set in Heartwood — Wren and Pell's craft as one. Spells cost less the closer you fight.

weapons.name: The Hallowed Censer
weapons.saga: Halvard's Oathweld bound to Pell's Heartwood. Its heals also seed a small ward on the Heart and the village's structures.
